workflow: The meetings can be live or virtual. With the pandemic continuing in many parts of the world, many companies will opt for virtual meetings in order to minimize the spread of illness. Virtual meetings bring many advantages, such as the ability to connect with people in different parts of the world. These meetings are more convenient and cost-effective, while still enabling collaboration and engagement.  In addition, they offer the flexibility to work remotely, even if travel is not possible.
